verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner split (headline left, photo right in proportion), but the date block's 'Tuesday to Sunday' line is unreadably tiny, the 'EXHIBITION' kicker sits at the end of the address line instead of above the headline, and the logo has shrunk to an illegible speck, so the hierarchy below the headline falls apart.
